name: Stock Ledger History
query:
SELECT 
    posting_date as "Date:Date:100",
    posting_time as "Time:Time:100",
    product as "Product:Link/Product:150",
    warehouse as "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
    qty as "Qty:Float:100",
    valuation_rate as "Valuation Rate:Currency:120",
    reference_type as "Ref Type:Link/DocType:120",
    reference_id as "Ref ID:Dynamic Link/reference_type:150"
FROM 
    `tabStock Ledger`
ORDER BY 
    posting_date DESC, posting_time DESC
